KS2 Class Teacher  
At Rygaards International School

Rygaards International School invites experienced, enthusiastic and well-qualified teachers, familiar with and experienced in British-style education, to apply for a KS2 teaching position.

Are you lively, energetic and committed? Are you a professional teacher and do you have a desire to contribute to the Primary Team and the community spirit of Rygaards? Are you a fluent English speaker and writer? Then maybe you are the candidate we are looking for to fill this full-time position.

Rygaards is a Catholic school, founded in 1909 by the Assumption sisters. The school has strong ecumenical traditions and welcomes applicants who are interested in actively supporting Christian values.

Rygaards School has a Danish and an International English-speaking department, each teaching its own separate curriculum. Rygaards International School consists of Key Stages 1–4 (Years 1–11).

We are looking for a teacher who has responsibility for a class in KS2 in the International School.

Applicants should be able to demonstrate:

• Excellent practice using a range of Assessment for Learning strategies to monitor ongoing progress in learning.
• High expectations and an ability to challenge each child through planned differentiation and clearly articulated learning objectives.
• Enthusiasm and teaching in a way that inspires the children and celebrates their achievements and abilities.

Terms of employment in accordance with contract between The Ministry of Finance and LC (Teaching Unions)

Information about the school can be obtained from our website www.rygaards.com

Employment: From 4th January 2027 to 30th June 2027

Closing date for applications: Friday, 27th November, 2026. 

Contact: Shirley Jacqueline Jacobsen - Head of International Primary School - shirley.jacobsen@rygaards.com

At Cellerator, the partnerships you will build make life-changing therapies possible. We are a philanthropic organisation founded and funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation, dedicated to turning cell-based therapies into treatments that reach the people who need them.

About the role

As our Business Development Specialist, you will turn interest from biotechs, spin-outs, academic groups and pharma into well-qualified programmes and signed agreements. You will assess scientific and strategic fit, guide clients through intake and due diligence, and shape proposals and deals. This is consultative business development, not hard selling. Just as importantly, you will design the commercial engine itself: the client journey, funnel, stage gates, CRM, pitch and pricing.

You will join a supportive team that values collaboration as we build the site together. If you are excited to shape how a new cell therapy facility partners with academia and industry from day one, this is the opportunity for you.

What you'll do

• Drive the funnel from first contact to signed agreement and a smooth handover to the Program Director and Project Manager, managing several opportunities at a time

• Assess the scientific, technical and strategic fit of programmes together with the Program Director and our Process Development and GMP experts, and lead intake and due diligence

• Build proposals and deals, including scope, assumptions, pricing input and timelines, and take them through contracting (NDA, MSA, SOW) with Legal and Finance

• Design and continuously improve our sales process and client journey: pipeline, lead criteria, stage gates, workshops, pitch materials and pricing models

• Own pipeline management and CRM, and work with Communications on campaigns, events, content and the website, so that marketing feeds the funnel

• Build long-term relationships with founders, academic teams, biotechs, pharma, investors and ecosystem partners, and represent Cellerator at events in the Nordics and Europe

What you'll bring

• An MSc in life sciences or a related field, with a strong understanding of drug development. Experience within cell or gene therapy is highly valued (PhD is an advantage)

• Around 8–10 years of professional experience, including solid experience in commercial or business development roles in drug development – ideally from a CDMO, CRO or biotech.

• The scientific credibility to understand cell therapy programmes and translate technical considerations into commercial discussions

• Experience working with structured sales processes, funnels or client journeys, combined with the ability and motivation to help build and improve our commercial setup.

• Hands-on experience with CRM, structured pipeline management and contracts such as MSAs, SOWs and change orders (SAP experience and an understanding of demand generation and marketing are an advantage)

• Excellent English, written and spoken (Danish and a network in the Nordic or European cell therapy ecosystem are an advantage)

• An entrepreneurial, consultative people person who builds trust quickly, is credible with scientists and executives alike, and is comfortable designing structure in an organisation that is still taking shape

Interested?

Send your CV and a short note about why this role interests you. We review applications on an ongoing basis, so do not wait for the deadline.

Life at Cellerator

We’re building something meaningful from the ground up. If you thrive in complexity, value pragmatic solutions over perfect theory, and want your work to directly influence how advanced therapies reach patients, you’ll feel at home here.

Built with you, not before you. We’re a scale-up, so our processes, culture, and ways of working are still taking shape. You won’t inherit a rigid playbook—you’ll help create it.

Work well, sustainably. We take work–life balance seriously and aim for a supportive, enjoyable workplace. Good science happens when people feel trusted, supported, and able to do their best work.

Flat by design. We work across teams rather than in silos. Whether you’re collaborating with GMP production, academic partners, or leadership, your perspective matters. We prioritise partnership over hierarchy.

Backed, but independent. The Novo Nordisk Foundation provides the stability and credibility to deliver on our mission. At the same time, our culture and direction are distinctly our own, and we move with the pace and spirit of a scale-up.

**Sales Development Representative for the German-Speaking Market, Copenhagen based

****Are you motivated by new business, building relationships and creating measurable results?

**At EasyTable, you will become part of an international sales team in Copenhagen, working directly with restaurants across Germany, Switzerland and Austria.

We are looking for Sales Development Representatives who can create business opportunities, build relationships with restaurant owners and demonstrate the value EasyTable can bring to their business.

You will take ownership of your own sales activities and drive opportunities forward from first contact to a paying customer.

This is an opportunity to build a career in B2B sales in Copenhagen while working directly with the German-speaking market and taking ownership of your own customer pipeline.

**The position

**As a Sales Development Representative for the German-speaking market, you will be responsible for growing EasyTable's customer base in Germany. This is a role focused on proactive sales, where you will manage your own pipeline and work towards clear individual targets.

You will be based at our office in Østerbro, Copenhagen, working alongside an international team while taking ownership of developing the German-speaking market.

**Your Key Responsibilities

**

• Identify and proactively reach out to restaurant owners across Germany, Switzerland and Austria

• Understand potential customers' businesses, challenges and needs

• Book and conduct online demonstrations of EasyTable

• Present EasyTable's value proposition based on each restaurant's needs

• Follow up consistently and drive opportunities from first contact to agreement

**About You

**

• Speak and write German at a native level

• Can communicate professionally in English

• Enjoy proactive sales and reaching out to new potential customers

• Are confident speaking with customers by phone and in online meetings

• Are good at building trust and relationships

• Take responsibility for your own performance and follow opportunities through

• Are motivated by targets and seeing the direct results of your work

• As we are looking for someone to start at the beginning of next month, or as soon as possible thereafter, we ideally expect candidates to already be based in Copenhagen or the surrounding area.

Previous experience with B2B sales is an advantage, but it is not a requirement. Motivation, commercial drive and the willingness to learn are important to us.

**What can you expect from us?

**You will get a role with clear goals, responsibility for your own sales activities and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings.

**We Offer

**

• A fixed salary plus uncapped commission based on your results

• Thorough onboarding in EasyTable, our product and our sales process

• Ongoing coaching and support to develop your sales skills

• An international working environment with colleagues from different backgrounds

• A modern office in Østerbro, Copenhagen

• Option to participate in our attractive company lunch programme

• Friday bars and other social activities

• One or two annual company trips

• Free Red Bull, tea and coffee at the office

**Working hours

**This is a full-time position of 37 hours per week. We offer flexibility in how you structure your working day, and your hours may vary depending on your preferences and the market you work with.

**About EasyTable

**EasyTable is a restaurant booking platform that helps restaurants manage reservations and create better experiences for their guests. From our Copenhagen office, our international team works with restaurants across Europe.

As Sales Development Representative for the German-speaking market, you will play an important role in growing our customer base in Germany and introducing more restaurants to EasyTable. You will join a team where sales performance, personal responsibility and development are central, while working in a social and international environment in Copenhagen.

**Could this be you?

**If you speak and write German at a native level, live in or around Copenhagen and are motivated by building a career in B2B sales, we would like to hear from you.

Send your CV and application here or to the email provided under contact information.

If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to contact HR & Recruitment Assistant Emilia Bech (Working hours: Monday, Wednesday and Thursday from 9:00 to 14:00)

Do you want to help shape the future of data and analytics in a global MedTech company?

Ambu is on an exciting digital transformation journey, investing heavily in our Enterprise Data Platform to strengthen data-driven decision-making across the business. We are looking for a Data Engineer to join our Data & Analytics team at our headquarters in Denmark and play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining enterprise-scale data solutions.

Working with modern Microsoft technologies and cloud-based solutions on Azure, you will collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, system managers, and fellow data professionals to deliver impactful solutions that support critical business processes across our global organization.

This is a unique opportunity to combine your software engineering background with data engineering expertise while contributing to innovative healthcare solutions that improve patient care worldwide.

**The role

**As a Data Engineer, You Will Be Involved In The Design, Development And Support Of Solutions Across Ambu's Data Landscape, Including

• Enterprise Data Warehouse solutions

• Master Data Management (MDM) solutions

• Data integrations and APIs

• Cloud-based Azure data services

• Bespoke data solutions supporting various business functions

**Your Key Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Designing, developing and maintaining enterprise data solutions

• Building and supporting data integration pipelines and interfaces

• Collaborating with business stakeholders to understand and translate requirements into technical solutions

• Ensuring data quality, reliability and performance across the data platform

• Participating in project delivery, testing and solution deployment activities

• Supporting and enhancing existing data solutions

• Contributing to data governance, architecture and best practices

• Identifying opportunities to improve and modernize the data platform

**Suggested candidate profile

**Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine you have a robust educational background in computer science, software engineering, data science, or a related field, combined with hands-on experience building and supporting data solutions in a modern cloud environment.

As a person, you are proactive, curious, collaborative, and motivated by solving complex business challenges through technology.

**More Specifically, You Bring

**

• Around 5 years of experience Data Engineering, Data Warehousing and Data Integration

• A background in Software Engineering and experience applying software development principles and best practices

• Strong SQL and data modelling skills

• Experience with Microsoft Azure data technologies and cloud services

• Experience developing ETL/ELT solutions, data pipelines, and integrations

• Knowledge of APIs and data integration patterns

• Understanding of Data Warehousing, Master Data Management (MDM), Data Quality, and Data Governance principles

• Experience with Python, C# or similar programming languages

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

**Please note that due to the upcoming summer holiday period, the recruitment process may take slightly longer than usual. We expect to begin the interview process in August.

****Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

**Job Requisition ID #

**26WD101877

**Principal Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Technical Advisory is seeking a highly technical and customer-focused Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions to join our new Embedded Engineering (forward-deployed engineering) team.

You will work directly alongside strategic Autodesk customers to discover high-value workflows, model the data those workflows depend on, and build the AI systems for their Design & Make workflows to enable customer’s measurable business outcomes.

You will move fluidly from understanding a customer's workflow and architecture to writing code. You will spend your weeks writing production code to build agents and orchestration, retrieval and graph services, connectors and APIs - inside customer environments, alongside customer engineers. What you ship is concrete: AI agents, MCP servers and tools, domain and semantic models, knowledge-graph extensions, retrieval and context-resolution pipelines, integrations into ERP, PLM, BIM, enterprise data platforms, and eval harnesses to move new capabilities into production.

Unlike traditional project delivery, Embedded Engineering works deeply inside customer environments, connecting Autodesk technology and data with the rest of the enterprise. Insights developed through customer work will be translated into reusable agents, connectors, reference architectures, engineering patterns, and direct product feedback that shapes Autodesk's platform roadmap.

The successful candidate combines strong software and AI engineering skills with curiosity, customer empathy, business judgment, and the ability to operate independently when the problem is not yet well defined. This role is engagement-driven with travel up to 75% during active engagements, including extended periods working onsite with customers.

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.

**Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed below.

**Responsibilities

****Discover Workflows and Own the Outcome

**

• Partner with customer executives, business leaders, and technical teams to translate transformation objectives, operational KPIs, sustainability commitments, and digital initiatives into measurable, AI-enabled workflow outcomes.

• Lead co-innovation with customers to find high-value workflows, decision bottlenecks, data requirements, and integration opportunities, turning ambiguous business challenges into clear technical directions.

• Analyze end-to-end workflows across Autodesk and non-Autodesk systems to pinpoint friction, process inefficiency, data gaps, and the places where AI and agents genuinely change the economics.

• Own technical execution end-to-end - rapid prototype through architecture, build, integration, testing, governance, production deployment guidance, and adoption - with accountability for customer impact.

• Sequence the work and decide what not to build. Make explicit trade-offs between scope, speed, and durability, and defend them to both customer and Autodesk stakeholder

**Make Data and Context AI-Ready

**

• Assess customer data readiness - fragmented sources, ownership, quality, lineage, metadata, governance, permissioning, and integration constraints - required to support trusted AI and agentic workflows.

• Structure and connect design intent, project, product, and asset data, along with requirements, supporting evidence, approvals, decisions, and dependencies, into trusted AI-ready data and context models that enable reasoning, retrieval, and agentic action.

• Design ontologies, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs that business users recognize and agents can act on, including entity resolution across source systems, schema mapping, and permission models that survive contact with enterprise reality.

**Build and Ship Production AI

**

• Design and build production-grade AI-enabled workflows, agents, applications, and integrations that connect Autodesk products and platform capabilities with customers' broader enterprise technology environments.

• Build the retrieval and context layer these systems depend on - hybrid search, graph-grounded retrieval, tool interfaces, and MCP servers that expose governed enterprise context to agents safely.

• Make quality measurable. Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, guardrails, tracing, and observability so that agent behavior is testable before launch and monitored after it, and so that quality regressions and drift are caught in production rather than reported by users.

• Apply strong engineering practices across architecture, code quality, security, permissions, reliability, observability, testing, performance, and maintainability, adapting quickly to complex and constrained customer environments.

• Define the operating model for what you build - runbooks, ownership, escalation, and cost - and hand it over cleanly to customer teams or Autodesk services so value persists after the engagement ends.

**Feed the Product and Build Reusable IP

**

• Act as a frontline product discovery mechanism, translating customer learning into prioritized product requirements, platform capability gaps, roadmap recommendations, and opportunities for feature or API acceleration.

• Convert customer-specific learning into reusable Autodesk value - reference architectures, agent and MCP patterns, connectors, ontology templates, graph models, reusable code, evals, and technical playbooks - that reduces the cost of every engagement that follows.

**Build an AI-Native Practice

**

• Design, build, and operationalize the agents, workflows, and automations that make the Embedded Engineering organization itself faster and more effective, measuring success by both customer impact and scalable internal leverage. Continuously look for manual work to replace with agentic systems and reusable internal tooling.

• Stay at the frontier. Maintain working knowledge of new model capabilities, agent implementation patterns, and AI product development stacks, and bring what's genuinely useful into practice.

• Serve as a trusted technical advisor across the boundary - partnering with customer engineers, architects, and business leaders, and with Autodesk Sales, Customer Success, Technical Advisory, Product, and Platform teams - to unblock delivery and help teams navigate ambiguity, trade-offs, risk, and changing requirements.

**Minimum Qualifications

**

• 6+ years building and operating production software, including 2+ in a customer-facing or embedded role (forward-deployed or founding engineer). CS/Engineering degree or equivalent hands-on experience.

• Full-stack range. Expert Python plus one of TypeScript, Java, or C# - comfortable across backend, data pipelines, integrations, and a lightweight React surface when a workflow needs one.

• Cloud fluency in Azure or AWS: containers, serverless, managed data stores, and identity and networking inside customer-governed environments (e.g., infrastructure as code with Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation), with strong API, distributed-systems, CI/CD, and observability fundamentals.

• Agentic systems in production. You've built and run single- and multi-agent systems - tool schemas, memory, human-in-the-loop checkpoints - on a modern orchestration framework (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain, Bedrock AgentCore, etc), MCP making practical cost and latency trade-offs (e.g., model selection, caching).

• Evaluation as engineering. You build golden datasets and eval harnesses from real customer data, and you measure groundedness, task success, and retrieval quality using standard tooling (e.g., RAGAS, LangSmith, Langfuse).

• Retrieval and data readiness. You've built retrieval systems end-to-end (chunking, embeddings, hybrid search, reranking) over a vector store and can assess and fix messy enterprise data - lineage, permissions, entity resolution, schema mapping.

• Knowledge architecture for AI. You model domain semantics into AI-ready context - ontologies, semantic layers, knowledge graphs - and ground agents in it via GraphRAG or equivalent, using at least one graph technology (e.g., Azure Cosmos DB Gremlin, Amazon Neptune, Neo4j, or equivalent) and its query language (e.g. Gremlin, Cypher, SPARQL).

• Ownership under ambiguity. You take greenfield customer problems from framing to production and measured outcomes and can explain a non-deterministic system with equal credibility to an engineer and an executive.

**Work arrangement

**

• You'll work with one customer at a time on focused engagements, for specified duration, on-site at customer locations that may be outside your home country, with travel of up to 75%, subject to any immigration or other requirements (averages likely to be lower across the whole year). You remain an Autodesk employee throughout, and the intention is that Autodesk's policies, benefits, and time off apply on every assignment. Some customers may have their own onboarding, safety, security or other requirements, which will be discussed with you at the time.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Domain fluency in AECO, with the ability to ramp quickly on design-to-construction-to-operations processes.

• Autodesk platform fluency: Autodesk Platform Services (APS), AEC Data Model API, Autodesk Construction Cloud and Common Data Environment (CDE) concepts, Forma, Fusion, Flow, and Autodesk data models.

• Enterprise systems of record integration: ERP, PDM, PLM, BIM, project controls, cost, scheduling, and asset management, plus enterprise data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, Lakehouse, analytics platforms).

• Constrained enterprise deployment: customer VPCs, private, on-prem, or air-gapped environments, data residency and sovereignty requirements, SSO/SCIM, and formal security review processes.

• AI-native builder practice: routine use of AI coding agents, harnesses, and automation to multiply individual and team throughput, including spec-driven development: writing clear specs and executable acceptance criteria for coding agents, keeping changes small and reviewable, and verifying AI-generated code through automated tests and review.

• Production trust and safety: prompt-injection defense, permission-aware retrieval, provenance and audit trails, versioning, staged rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

**Ideal Candidate

**

• Ships. Has put things into production and can name the metric that moved.

• Treats evaluation as part of the product. Assumes agents will fail and builds evaluation, observability, and guardrails before scaling.

• Is fluent in both worlds. Understands the customer’s business process and the failure modes of non-deterministic systems.

• Thinks in reusable patterns. Instinctively asks, “How does this become an asset for the next ten customers?”

• Moves fast without leaving a mess. Knows when speed matters, when engineering rigor matters, and how to make that trade-off deliberately.

We are looking for a Financial Controller to lead the operational and analytical work behind our monthly close, group consolidation, project controlling and control environment of a fast-growing energy trading and technology group – and to rebuild them AI-first, so our numbers are faster, more reliable and ready for scale.

Why this role matters

Hybrid Greentech is scaling fast as a VPP, BRP and electricity retailer across Denmark, and Northern Europe. Energy trading means large and volatile daily revenue, cost and cash transactions – so quality , accuracy and liquidity control are not back-office topics; they decide how fast we can grow. This role exists to give management, the board and investors numbers they can trust, on time, and to build controls and automation that scale with the business rather than with headcount. The same discipline is needed in our consultancy arm, where technical consultants deliver advisory and EPC management projects: clear project economics, timely invoicing and early warning when a project drifts.

The role

As Financial Controller, you report to our Finance Manager and work closely with the CFO and our accountant in a small, hands-on finance team. You lead the operational and analytical work within the financial steering, reporting and finance and business analytics; running the month-end close, the consolidation of our group entities in Denmark and abroad, balance sheet reconciliations, project controlling and the day-to-day operation of our internal controls. This is an individual contributor role with high ownership and direct visibility towards management.

You will work in close collaboration with our settlement team, project managers and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting, partner with our accountant on more complex accounting topics, and work across trading, portfolio management, commercial and engineering. We are a tech-first company with high AI adoption, and we expect you to work that way too: AI tools, scripting and automation are your default approach to removing manual work from close, reconciliation and reporting – combined with the judgement to know when a number needs a human review.

What you will do

• Lead and execute the monthly close and group consolidation, including account mapping, intercompany eliminations, reconciliations and variance analysis, and prepare the monthly financial and business review for the CFO, management and the board.

• Set up and run project controlling – project budgets, hours and utilisation, work in progress, milestone and fixed-fee revenue recognition and timely invoicing – giving project managers and business owners clear steering on margin, estimate-to-complete and cash.

• Automate and rebuild our reporting flow – from ERP trial balances to consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow – using AI tools, scripting and data pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet steps with controlled, repeatable and documented processes.

• Operate and strengthen our internal controls within the framework set by the Finance Manager, including segregation of duties, payment and bank authorisations and documented business procedures, and drive follow-up on auditor recommendations.

• In close collaboration with Settlement, ensure trading-related balances – settlement, imbalance costs, customer prepayments and deposits, and collateral posted to TSOs, DSOs and exchanges – are correctly recognized, invoiced and reconciled

• Support cash and liquidity forecasting and management with the Finance Manager and CFO, including rolling cash forecasts, collateral and trading risk capital tracking, and early warning on cash exposure.

• Prepare and analyse the annual budget and monthly forecast updates for the Finance Manager and CFO, maintaining our driver-based budget model and following up on budget-versus-actual deviations with business owners.

• Handle key accounting areas such as revenue recognition and accruals, capitalisation of development projects, grant periodisation and month-end cost accruals, collaborating with our accountant on more complex accounting topics.

• Support in the year-end close and audit for all group entities, including annual reports, tax specifications and intercompany agreements, in close collaboration with Finance Manager and our external auditors.

• Work closely with our Settlement team and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting – turning data into insight on gross profit by revenue stream, cost of execution and unit economics, and building dashboards that let the business self-serve.

What you bring

Experience and skills (Required)

• 5+ years of experience as a controller, in audit or in a group finance role, ideally in a multi-entity set-up.

• A relevant degree in accounting, finance or economics (e.g. cand.merc., HD-R or cand.merc.aud.).

• Proven hands-on experience running month-end close, consolidation and year-end audit under the Danish Financial Statements Act (Årsregnskabsloven)

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably e-conomic

Build Continia’s test function from the ground up, and shape how we deliver quality across all our products.

Continia develops finance automation software built on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, .NET, web and mobile technologies. Our solutions for accounts payable automation, e-documents, expense management and bank integration help more than 20,000 customers worldwide automate everyday finance processes, delivered through a global network of more than 1,800 reselling partners.

As our products grow and increasingly ship together as a Continia Suite, quality across them matters more than ever. That is why we are building a new test function, and we are looking for the person who will lead it. You will set the direction, build the processes and lay the foundation for the team.

About the role

Our developers own the quality of their own code through unit and integration tests. What no single team owns today is the view across products. Does a change in one product affect another? Does the Continia Suite work as a whole? Are we ready to release? That is what this function is for, and you will be the one to build it.

You start by creating the roadmap. Where are our biggest quality challenges, which processes do we need, and what are the milestones? From there you build the function step by step. You keep it transparent where we are and when we need people from the product teams. You will work closely with our QA & Automation Engineer to decide what to automate and where AI can make our test processes faster.

A big part of the role is people. You will be the link between support, escalation engineers, developers and product managers. You listen to what they see, bring the right people together and turn what you learn into better testing.

What you’ll be doing

• Build the test function from scratch, including the roadmap, milestones, processes and, over time, the team.

• Define test strategy, quality criteria and release readiness with product managers and engineering managers.

• Own regression and coordinate testing across our all our products, so nothing is skipped before we ship.

• Work closely with support, escalation engineers, developers and product managers, and turn what they see into better testing.

• Work with UX to make sure new features are easy to understand and intuitive for users, not just that they meet the user story.

• Find the edge cases others miss, and match test depth to risk.

• Report quality trends and progress to leadership.

About you

• Experience leading QA or test work, ideally including building a test function or team from the ground up.

• Extensive software testing experience or QA, including test strategy for complex business applications.

• Practical experience using AI to improve test processes.

• Experience with ERP or finance software. Dynamics 365 Business Central is a strong advantage.

• Structured by nature. You create clarity, set up processes that last, and can say “not ready” with evidence while staying a good colleague to the teams you work with.

• ISTQB or a similar certification is an advantage.

• Fluent in English, written and spoken. Danish language skills are an advantage, but not required.

What we offer

At Continia, you’ll join an informal and collaborative environment where you’ll be empowered to grow professionally and personally.

• Competitive compensation package.

• A culture based on trust, responsibility and collaboration, where your ideas are taken seriously.

• Opportunities for professional growth and learning.

• A strong social environment where we celebrate successes and have fun together.

• Memorable company events with colleagues from around the world.

• Work at the intersection of technology and business, with an impact you can see.

The position is based at our office in Aalborg, and we expect you to be on site three days a week. The role is about working closely with support, developers and product teams, and being close to them makes it easier to keep a finger on the pulse and build strong relationships.

How to apply

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, please upload your CV along with a short motivation for your application.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. For questions about the position, please contact Senior Product Manager, Josefine Franck Christensen at jf@continia.com.

Continia is committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunities for all applicants with a Danish residence and work permit.

For GDPR and processing reasons, all applications and CVs must be uploaded via the provided link and not sent via email or otherwise.

About Continia

At Continia, we value diversity and encourage authenticity. We are team players who respect each other’s thoughts and ideas, and we expect everyone to take ownership of their work. We focus on personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization.

In our day-to-day work, we are pragmatic and result-oriented, and we aim to stay entrepreneurial by keeping things simple and focusing on our employees. We celebrate our wins and releases and aim to have one major event each year where all employees meet up in one place.

We recognize that time is what matters most. Continia solutions give customers more time every day to work and live. That’s why “It’s About Time” is our motto. Our success is built on partnering with more than 1,800 reselling partners, serving more than 20,000 customers worldwide.

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

At Genmab, we’re committed to building extra[not]ordinary futures together, by developing antibody products and pioneering, knock-your-socks-off therapies that change the lives of patients and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. From our people who are caring, candid, and impact-driven to our business, which is innovative and rooted in science, we believe that being proudly unique, determined to be our best, and authentic is essential to fulfilling our purpose.

**The Role and Department

**The Late Stage CMC Project organization is growing and we are looking for 2 Directors to lead and develop a team of Project Managers in Genmab’s late-stage CMC project organization.

The roles have similar responsibility and you will combine people leadership with strategic oversight and hands-on responsibility for complex CMC programs, including contribution to governance of outsourced activities with contract development and manufacturing organizations (CDMOs).

Both postions report to the Senior Director, Head of the Late-Stage Project Management Office, within Genmab Tech Ops in Denmark. Working closely with CMC, Regulatory Affairs, Quality and Supply Chain, you will align CMC delivery with development priorities and drive progress towards regulatory submission and commercial readiness.

You will help shape the late-stage project organization, develop experienced Project Managers and translate portfolio priorities into clear decisions and reliable delivery.

**Responsibilities

**Team leadership and development

• Lead and develop your team through resource planning, recruitment, performance management and succession planning, building capabilities for current and future portfolio needs

• Coach Project Managers in strategic thinking, cross-functional leadership and resolving complex CMC challenges. Set clear expectations, delegate effectively and build accountability for results

• Work closely with the Senior Director to prioritize resources and budgets across the team’s programs, resolve capacity constraints and align delivery with portfolio objectives

CMC strategy and project responsibilities

• Shape CMC strategies with technical and functional leads, aligned with overall Drug Development Plans. Lead assigned programs through integrated planning, budget analysis and management of cross-program dependencies.

• Drive cross-functional delivery of technology transfer, process validation, manufacturing readiness and submission documentation, with clear ownership and adherence to Genmab’s quality system and applicable regulatory requirements

• Ensure reliable plans, risk and decision logs, and executive reporting. Anticipate portfolio impacts, resolve high-impact issues and facilitate data-driven options and recommendations to senior governance forums

• Lead improvements to the Project Manual, governance and ways of working, including digital and AI-enabled tools that strengthen planning, risk management and delivery

**CDMO collaboration and project governance

**

• Representing Late Stage CMC Project Management in CDMO joint project and steering committees, facilitating strategic discussions and decisions within delegated authority. Ensure decisions translate into clear commitments and follow-through

• Shape outsourcing and partnership strategies with relevant functions, aligning proposals, contracts and quality agreements with program objectives, business needs and intellectual property considerations

• Hold partners accountable for agreed scope, quality, timelines and budgets. Build transparent relationships, resolve vendor conflicts and escalate strategic trade-offs and risks with clear recommendations

**Requirements

**

• Master’s degree or higher in natural sciences, pharmacy, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent experience

• Extensive biopharmaceutical CMC experience, including late-stage biologics development and progression towards commercial supply. Experience with antibody-drug conjugates is an advantage

• Proven experience shaping strategies and leading complex global CMC programs, including portfolio prioritization, strategic budget management and cross-functional risk resolution

• Established people-leadership experience, with a track record of developing Project Managers, building team capabilities and supporting talent and succession planning

• Strong understanding of technology transfer, process validation, submission strategies and the interdependencies between development, manufacturing and supply

• Experience shaping outsourcing strategies, leading CDMO governance and resolving complex partner issues with sound business judgment

• Advanced knowledge of GMP and global CMC regulatory expectations, including those relevant to FDA, EMA and NMPA submissions

• Excellent English communication skills, with a track record of influencing senior stakeholders and translating complex issues into clear business recommendations.

**About You

**You combine strategic perspective with the judgment to know when to engage directly and when to empower others. You develop people, set clear priorities and make well-founded decisions under uncertainty, balancing quality, timelines and cost.

You build trust across functions and cultures, challenge assumptions constructively and create an inclusive environment where colleagues take ownership. You champion a ONE-Team approach, welcome feedback and turn lessons learned into improvements across the project organization.

**Location and Travel

**The role is based in Denmark. Travel is expected to be approximately 10–15 days per year.

Genmab leverages the effectiveness of an agile working environment, when possible, for the betterment of employee work-life balance. Our offices are designed as open, community-based spaces that work to connect our employees. Whether you’re in one of our collaboratively designed office spaces or working remotely, we thrive on connecting with each other to innovate.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK883.200,00---1.324.800,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

Do you have experience developing medical devices? Would you like to be part of developing innovative products that make a meaningful difference to patients, while applying your skills in a global MedTech company that is helping shape the future of endoscopy?

Then your next career move could be as a Systems Engineer with Ambu.

**Be a Key Player in Engineering & Imaging

**In this exciting role, you will be a key contributor within our R&D organization and a leading technical member of a product development project. You will play a central role in shaping and delivering innovative endoscopy solutions, directly contributing to Ambu’s future success and to improved outcomes for patients and healthcare professionals.

As part of this position, you will join a team responsible for developing a go-to-market solution that introduces new product features AI capabilities to our existing portfolio of display units. This will enable us to gain valuable experience with AI-enabled solutions while preparing for the development of our next-generation display unit. The solution will support our current portfolio of endoscopy products while also laying the foundation for future platforms, capabilities, and product offerings.

You will be part of our Global Systems Engineering department and report to the Systems Engineering Team Manager. The position is based at our headquarter in Ballerup, Denmark, where you will join a collaborative, professional, and globally connected team.

We foster a strong culture of innovation, with a clear focus on fast time-to-market while remaining deeply committed to developing the right products to meet customer and user needs, ultimately improving patient care. This requires the ability to navigate complex medical device development and bring different technologies, disciplines, and perspectives together into coherent product solutions.

You will join a truly global Systems Engineering team of 22 highly skilled and motivated colleagues based across different locations. The team is part of Engineering & Imaging within our R&D organization and brings together a diverse mix of backgrounds, perspectives, and expertise. What really stands out is the team’s strong collaborative spirit and proven track record of successfully bringing Ambu’s innovative products to market, making it a great environment in which to learn, grow, and contribute.

**Global, User-Driven Innovation: From Idea to Launch

**As a Systems Engineer, you will hold the overall technical view of the product and help subject matter experts, project team members, and other stakeholders understand each other and work effectively together.

You will be leading technical alignment and discussions in the project team to find the right solution , helping drive and maintain the overall technical solution and ensuring coherence across the different technologies and disciplines involved. You will navigate technical trade-offs, facilitate decisions, and ensure that the product solution remains aligned with user needs, business objectives, regulatory requirements, and the overall system architecture.

You will create, facilitate, and review key product development documentation, including requirements, design inputs, design outputs, and technical reviews. You enjoy working in cross-functional project teams, finding pragmatic solutions to complex technical challenges, and ensuring an appropriate level of documentation and technical rigor.

You will be involved throughout the product development lifecycle, from early scope investigation and concept development through design, integration, verification and validation, and ultimately market launch.

We work in a hybrid setup, typically with minimum three days on-site in Ballerup, providing flexibility while maintaining strong team connections.

**Your Responsibilities

**

• Define, plan, document, and technically manage product development activities within the project to ensure the product is delivered in accordance with the defined design objectives and development plan.

• Identify and understand stakeholder and user needs through engagement with key stakeholders and users.

• Analyze and decompose user needs, business needs, and system requirements into clear and actionable product and development requirements.

• Leading technical alignment and discussions with the Project Manager and relevant Line Managers.

• Ensure alignment with product and technology architectures and promote the appropriate reuse of existing design solutions across the R&D organization.

• Investigate and scope new product concepts and solutions within existing or new clinical areas, building on Ambu’s technologies and capabilities.

• Establish and maintain the overall technical overview of the product, including system interfaces, dependencies, and trade-offs between technologies and design solutions.

• Ensure development, documentation, verification, and testing activities are performed in accordance with applicable FDA, ISO, IEC, and internal quality requirements.

Your stakeholder base will be broad, and you will collaborate across Ambu’s global organization, with functions involved throughout product development, as well as externally with users, knowledge centers, technical partners, and suppliers.

Our production sites are located in Malaysia, China, the USA, and Mexico, and we collaborate with KOLs and development centers across Europe, Asia, and the US. Some travel should therefore be expected, approximately 20 days per year.

**Suggested Candidate Profile

**Setting you up for success is one of our cornerstones. We imagine that you are proactive, driven, committed, and comfortable taking responsibility and ownership. You are thorough and quality-minded, with strong interpersonal skills and good situational awareness, enabling you to work effectively in cross-functional and global teams.

**Skills

**Skills and experience can be gained in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for a role cannot always be defined on paper. That said, you are likely to thrive in this role if you bring:

• A degree or professional background in electrical engineering, mechatronics, mechanical engineering, biomedical engineering, or a similar technical field, together with relevant hands-on product development experience.

• Experience developing medical devices, including working with design control and requirements in a regulated environment, or comparable experience from another highly regulated industry.

• Experience in cross-functional product development involving hardware, electronics, mechanics, and software, ideally within medical devices or a related engineering or consultancy environment.

• A strong systems engineering mindset combined with a practical approach to developing robust and reliable product solutions.

• The ability to work independently, take ownership, and remain pragmatic and solution-oriented while actively sharing knowledge and collaborating within a global team.

• Experience working with an OEM, contract manufacturer, or external development partner would be an advantage.

• A solid understanding of relevant standards for medical electrical equipment, such as IEC 60601-1, IEC 60601-2-18, and ISO 80601-2-18, and experience translating regulatory and standards requirements into practical product development activities would also be an advantage

As Ambu is a global company, it is important that you communicate fluently in English. Only applications submitted in English will be considered.

**How To Apply

**We invite candidates for interviews on a continuous basis, so please do not hesitate to apply via our career site at ambu.com.

Your application will be treated confidentially.

_Please do not contact us or apply if you are a recruiter, consultant, or outsourcing company.

_Join a team of fintech heroes! 🚀

Performativ is changing the way investment advisors and financial institutions operate. We are building a modern platform for portfolio management, reporting, compliance, trading, and client engagement, replacing fragmented systems, manual workflows, and technology built for another era.

Our platform depends on accurate and timely data from custodians, banks, brokers, and other financial institutions. These connections provide the positions, transactions, cash movements, instruments, and corporate actions used throughout the investment-management lifecycle.

You can read more about our product at performativ.com.

As our new Software Engineer, Investment Data Integrations 📈

You will help build and operate the systems that connect Performativ with custodians and other providers of investment data.

The immediate challenge is practical: we need to deliver a growing number of integrations while maintaining the existing portfolio and resolving real production issues. The longer-term challenge is to avoid a scaling trap where every new institution requires another collection of manual processes and bespoke code.

We are building a more automated integration platform with reusable pipelines, mappings, reconciliation, quality controls, and AI-assisted development. Your work will contribute both to integrations customers need now and to the foundations that let the team deliver future integrations faster and more safely.

• You will develop and maintain integrations covering positions, transactions, cash, instruments, prices, corporate actions, and other investment data across files, APIs, SFTP, and message-based interfaces.

• You will build reusable ingestion, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and monitoring capabilities instead of treating each provider as an isolated implementation.

• You will investigate complex data and production issues across internal systems, external providers, and customer environments, then deliver permanent fixes that prevent known classes of problems from recurring.

• You will work closely with users, operations specialists, and other engineers to understand the complete workflow and ensure that integrated data is correct and useful throughout the platform.

• You will direct AI agents to produce much of the implementation, review their assumptions and output critically, and establish the tests, controls, and evidence required for safe deployment.

You should bring strong backend or data-engineering judgment and experience with production systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience with financial integrations, investment data, reconciliation, ETL pipelines, APIs, structured files, or regulated systems would be valuable. Familiarity with technologies such as Python, Golang, PHP, TypeScript, MySQL, Redis, AWS, and CI/CD tooling is useful, but experience with our exact stack is not essential.

We value your passion 🔥

At Performativ, we are builders first. We have ambitious goals and value the time, judgment, and effort people put into their work. You will be trusted to make your mark and help shape how we solve difficult problems.

We do not divide the platform into personal territories. People develop deeper context in different areas, but we solve problems as a team. We expect people to lead when appropriate, follow through on what they take on, contribute to the work of others, and help teammates succeed.

AI can help us understand formats, generate mappings, develop implementations, and test integrations faster. It does not replace financial-domain understanding, careful validation, or accountability for the resulting data.

This role is based in Copenhagen. We work together primarily from our city-centre office, with flexibility to work from home when it makes sense. You should already be based in Copenhagen or be ready to relocate.

What we can offer you 🌱

• Work on integrations at the centre of a production wealth-management platform.

• Solve difficult problems involving financial data, external systems, reconciliation, reliability, and operational workflows.

• Help create an AI-assisted approach to developing and maintaining integrations safely at scale.

• An ambitious, collaborative team with experience from leading technology companies, consultancies, and financial institutions.

• Strong opportunities to deepen both your engineering capabilities and your understanding of investment management.
